name: Project Browser API Browser
description: Create Project Browsers that connect with external APIs.

suggests.drupal/key: Store API credentials as keys so that secrets stay out of exported configuration.

project_description:
The Project Browser API Browser module lets you build Project Browser sources from external APIs, so that content administrators can browse a curated list of projects without leaving the site.

Describe an API once — where it lists projects, where it describes a single project, and how its JSON response maps onto the fields Project Browser expects — and it becomes a tab in Project Browser alongside the sources that ship with core. Each connection is stored as an 'API Browser Service' configuration entity; every service is derived into its own Project Browser source plugin. A listing endpoint supplies the set of projects and an optional per-project endpoint fills in detail; JMESPath selects the records out of each response and Twig templates reshape them onto Project Browser's fields without writing PHP. Authentication supports API key, bearer token, basic auth and OAuth 2.0 client credentials, with the optional Key module keeping the secret itself out of exported configuration. Endpoints that page by number or by cursor are supported, requests are sent concurrently and retried with a backoff on 429/503, and results are cached and rebuilt on save or refresh. Requires Drupal 11.2+ / 12, Project Browser 2.1+ and PHP 8.3+; the 2.x branch dropped Drupal 10.
